notice.title: Corrigendum No: 39/2026 Regarding Seat position and Eligibility for the INI-SS DM/M.Ch. January 2027 Session

clauses.text: With reference to the notification No.F-1-2/125th SAC/2026-(P&T Cell) dated 29th June 2026, regarding the incorporation of MD Emergency Medicine as an eligibility qualification for DM Critical Care Medicine in INI-SS Entrance Examination, the eligibility criterion stands revised as follows:

REVISED ELIGIBILITY CRITERION MD in Anaesthesiology/Medicine/Chest Medicine of this institute or any other university or equivalent degree recognized by the NMC MD in Anaesthesiology/Medicine/Chest Medicine/Emergency Medicine of this institute or any other university or equivalent degree…
Important: For Guidelines, number of seats, eligibility criteria, detailed information, etc., please visit the website www.aiimsexams.ac.in
